unshown_text.text: All three covenants in the approved terms are reported in the summary table on the first page; the borrower reports non-compliance with the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio.
No embedded instructions were found in the document.

The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for the four quarters ended September 30, 2026 came out at {{fact:3e25c14d-37d3-40d2-b995-7f155db348fd}}. Section 6.1 requires at least {{fact:96526fb0-3f31-4d0a-a1ea-1eed755f60f1}}, so the ratio falls short by {{fact:47368e5d-9530-498c-bb3f-6ccd8b1b8bf5}} of the requirement. The borrower's Q3 2026 compliance certificate reports the same ratio, {{fact:70093d31-8e18-4b20-a9b5-90bc20f9d671}}, and says the borrower was not in compliance. The definition uses no add-backs, so no cap could explain the gap. Only one version of the terms is on file, the original 2021 agreement. There are no unapproved amendments, and a search of the documents found no waiver. Section 9.1 says a waiver is effective only if it is in writing and signed by both the lender and the borrower. Rerunning the test under version 1 gave the same result, {{fact:4a01a847-3b11-47e8-b538-603055c22c4a}} against {{fact:20e9ee29-1b9a-4f60-98f9-7fc0b260abbd}}. Nothing on file explains the failure, so this looks like a true breach.

Rerunning the test under the approved terms gave the same result, {{fact:4a01a847-3b11-47e8-b538-603055c22c4a}} against {{fact:20e9ee29-1b9a-4f60-98f9-7fc0b260abbd}}. Nothing on file explains the failure, so this looks like a true breach.
No separate over-advance line is printed; the certificate shows a single combined line labelled Availability (over-advance), reported under availability, so over_advance is omitted.
The Inventory sublimit line on the certificate does not match any requested line name and was not reported; advance rate percentage rows were skipped.
The aging and inventory pages also state units in U.S. dollars; the certificate page statement is reported.
The aging total row and the inventory total row were excluded as instructed.
The inventory page states that inventory was last counted at the most recent fiscal year end, with quantities from perpetual records.
No embedded instructions were found in the document.

Fixed charge coverage was {{fact:3e25c14d-37d3-40d2-b995-7f155db348fd}} against a covenant minimum of {{fact:96526fb0-3f31-4d0a-a1ea-1eed755f60f1}}, leaving headroom of {{fact:47368e5d-9530-498c-bb3f-6ccd8b1b8bf5}}. Because the headroom is negative, coverage sits below the required level rather than merely near it. Cash flow is covering fixed charges with less cushion than the lender required. No other signal fired to corroborate or explain it.
